analysis.summary: EDEFuzz detects Excessive Data Exposure, where a web API sends clients far more data than they need, often over public channels. The authors note the problem has no explicit oracle -- nothing crashes -- and develop a metamorphic relation to supply one, building the first fuzzer for it. Across 69 targets from the Alexa Top-200 it found 33,365 potential leaks, and on eight websites it reached a 98.65% true positive rate.
analysis.narrative: One citation, in a list of systems where metamorphic relations have been used successfully to find bugs.
